status_meanings.supported: Active, required, or provisionally helpful; never live-trading approval.
status_meanings.mixed: Conflicting, small, exploratory, or unconfirmed evidence.
status_meanings.harmful: Rejected, noisy, disconnected, or harmful in its tested form.
status_meanings.protected: Prediction label, evaluation-only field, or sealed confirmation data.

guardrail: Coordinates, bubble sizes, colors, and visual separation remain hypotheses until they improve an out-of-sample metric. The final holdout remains sealed.
